name: ios-agent-mcp
description: Static analysis for modern iOS/Swift projects — Swift 6 actor isolation, architecture boundaries, SwiftUI, availability guards, and App Store readiness — plus a linter for Agent Skill repositories.
author: Nagarjuna Reddy

permissions.notes: Reads .swift, Info.plist, Package.swift, and project.pbxproj files under the path you pass to a tool. Makes no network requests and writes nothing.

tools.name: analyze_swift_project
tools.summary: Project overview plus a finding count for every rule category.

tools.name: review_swift_concurrency
tools.summary: Swift 6 actor isolation and concurrency defects.

tools.name: review_swiftui
tools.summary: SwiftUI view and state defects, Dynamic Type, design tokens.

tools.name: audit_app_store_readiness
tools.summary: Purpose strings, privacy manifest, accessibility, localization.

tools.name: review_swift_memory
tools.summary: Retain cycles, weak/unowned usage, closure and Task lifetime.

tools.name: review_swift_security
tools.summary: Hardcoded secrets, insecure storage, ATS, TLS, weak crypto, Keychain accessibility.

tools.name: review_swift_testing
tools.summary: Flaky patterns, vacuous tests, live network in tests, missing coverage.

tools.name: review_swift_performance
tools.summary: Work inside body, eager stacks, unstable ForEach identity, blocking I/O.

tools.name: lint_skill
tools.summary: Agent Skill metadata: frontmatter, subagent tool grants, mirror sync, doc references.

resources.summary: Structure, architecture with evidence, DI, frameworks.
Every finding across all nine categories.

notes: Resources require a project root: pass --project PATH or set IOS_AGENT_PROJECT. Tools take an explicit path argument and need no configuration.
